extraction_report.paper_summary: CrossPPI is a cross-attention-based deep learning model that fuses sequence (ESM-2 embeddings + 1D CNN) and graph (contact-map + GAT) views from ligand and receptor proteins via a transformer-style cross-fusion module to predict protein–protein binding affinity (pKD). Trained and evaluated on the PPB-Affinity dataset with cross-validation; authors provide training scripts, preprocessing for ESM-2 contact maps/embeddings, and pre-trained checkpoints.
